messages.message:
Patch Set 13:

(13 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The largest one is in config/Makefile.exports.in: exporting CONFIG_LNET_XPRT_IB for EXTERNAL_KO2IBLND changes which directories the out-of-tree kbuild pass descends into, and breaks `make modules` for the common external-OFED-only configuration. The rest of the build-system conversion is mechanical and looks right, but several of the new Kconfig symbols do not correspond to anything the C code tests.

Patch Set 14:

(8 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. Two of them look like they stop the copied tree from building at all (the unrewritten #include_next shim, and the workqueue_attrs renames), so a refresh seems needed; the rest are minor and can ride along. Nothing in CI exercises the result of copy-builtin, so a small smoke target that runs the script against a kernel tree and builds it would catch this class of problem before review.

commit.subject: LU-18876 build: copy-builtin
commit.message:
LU-18876 build: copy-builtin

It's useful, for the upstreaming effort, distribution packagers,
and general development, to be able to build the Lustre kernel
modules natively as part of the Linux build. Some projects
(such as openZFS) have a script to automatically port their
kernel modules to the Linux tree. Lustre should have the same.

This patch implements such a script.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: I8fdbddd0d522f848541ae80f4873f8af1c957dc4
